description: Frozen ledger of reason codes that error-code-registry.json registers but no other machine artifact under spec/v1/artifacts references as a bare token (generated reports excluded). Adopted by ruling 2026-09-04-1752 after invalid_task_fsm_transition was found to describe a state machine that no event kind, cell family or fsm contract could ever produce. The list is a ratchet: check_reason_code_producer_paths fails on any new unreferenced code and on any listed code that gains a reference without being dropped here. removed_reason_codes pins codes a ruling deleted so they cannot return.

removed_reason_codes.why: v1 举报队列两态，明文禁止中间态（content-moderation.md:209-220）；“clustered”语义由 require_review 承载。

Named recipient_method=hardware_wrapped_key, which is not a v1 enum value, and trusted_recovery_service.attestation_required, which ruling 0032 deleted together with the hardware attestation framework. No v1 carrier can raise it.
join 路径按构造不存在（audit applet 非 MLS 成员）；release 侧由已登记 audit_release_attestation_mismatch 承载。
v1 无 key-destruction attestation 载体事件（event-kind-registry 无任何 destruction 类 audit kind），校验不存在。
不存在“agent 持有 epoch secret 销毁证明”对象（applet 不持有 epoch key material），校验无附着点。
新模型审计材料经 sealed release session 输出，无 agent epoch 访问范围概念。
v1 无“agent 持有 epoch 密钥→迁移销毁”状态机，该 reason code 无产生路径。
无 audit-agent 成员资格，remove+destruction 配对校验按构造不可达。
v1 封闭 defer 集合（dependency_missing/quorum_unreachable/temporarily_unavailable，event-auth-state-resolution.md §:617-618）明文排除；条件由已登记 dependency_missing 承载。
标准关系冲突由 require_review 收敛；并发候选上限由 relation_conflict_fanout_exceeded 承载。协议不提供关系数量限制配置。
同一条件由已登记且已接线的 keypackage_claim_rate_limited 承载（device-lifecycle.md:783 + fixture + soland）。
v1 有无界 `counter` 状态模型，但未定义 parameters.max/min 或 escrow 配额；因此不存在 counter_bound_exceeded，发行者重复/分叉操作由 Event 身份冲突与普通因果收敛规则处理。
校验不存在且正文主动排除（relation.md:171）；跨 Realm 情形由已登记 cross_realm_structural_relation 承载。
校验存在但正文钉给 schema_violation（applet-integration.md:926 normative MUST）；无路径产出此 reason code，产出反违反 §11。
“genesis submit window” 概念在任何 registry/schema/正文不存在；created_at 过去向漂移按设计不校验。

Its whole precondition is gone: AuthorityRevision, trusted_history_base_basis, trusted_current_basis and the direct-traversal retention target were deleted with the authority-commit clean break. No spec/v1 file outside this registry names any of them, so no producer can reach this branch and none can be written without reintroducing the deleted revision model.

Described a Realm-profile-declared task/workflow fsm cell that v1 cannot carry: event kinds, cell families and transition_contracts are frozen at registration time and no registered producer can write a Realm-declared extension family. zh/models/common-fields.md 5.3.4 rules that v1 has no workflow profile carrier.
wire 无 join_authorisation 字段（membership_payload 封闭）；join 证明失败由 gate_check_failed/capability_denied 承载。
v1 无收紧触发的隐式终结边（common-fields.md:486-498 逐字禁止隐式边）；后续 join 拒绝由 gate_check_failed 承载。

It guards the decryption_failed to late_recovered upgrade. late_recovered exists in no spec/v1 file, and zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md section 6 now defines late arrival purely as applying missing Commits and recipient deliveries in order, with no retroactive plaintext upgrade state to reject. decryption_failed stays; its upgrade path does not exist to guard.
条件由已接线顶层 code unsupported_event_kind/unsupported_feature 承载（conformance-profiles.md:71, api-conventions.md:408）。
无独立 lift 信号通道；由 sealed ak.moderation.decision.lift Event 经普通 sync 承载；sync frame 为封闭枚举。
跨 peer moderation 只许 sealed 承载（content-moderation.md:80），fast-path quarantine 信号构造不存在。
lint 发现不是 wire reason code（按构造无 wire 路径）；且描述前提与正文矛盾（api-conventions.md:636/index.md:39 规定版本由 event kind 后缀承载）。
“认得但不托管”分流在 v1 不存在；由 not_found（反枚举统一桶）与 route-miss pending 语义承载（conformance-vectors.md §35/§36）。

It encodes the CBS data-plane / control-plane effect split. That split was deleted with CBS; zh/authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md section 4, which the description cites as its source, no longer contains a plane rule, and no typed current result family is classified by plane anywhere. A reducer projection that targets the wrong family now fails as reducer_projection_failed against the registered result contract.
承载已由已登记顶层 code recovery_session_not_pending（codes[]，409）覆盖：session 不在 pending 的全部分支（含 terminal 的 completed/rejected/expired）由该顶层判定统一拒绝，v1 无需独立 terminal reason。
关系数量限制配置不属于协议目标，删除配置及其专属拒绝原因。
关系数量限制配置不属于协议目标，删除配置及其专属拒绝原因。
grant/revoke 顺序由 or_set observed-remove 与 joined control view 确定性裁决，“不可确定”态按构造不存在。

Capability revoke-undo (rollback) is not defined anywhere in v1: revoke_undo appears in no prose, schema, registry or fixture, and zh/authz/capabilities.md defines no undo of an accepted revoke. A revoke whose signature does not verify is rejected at admission like any other Event; there is no undo object to attach this reason to.
§10.1 收窄违规由已登记且正文已点名的 grant_exceeds_issuer_authority 承载（capabilities.md:165 + soland apply_capability.rs:1046/1105）。

Only reachable during threshold_recovery share reconstruction. Ruling 0032 deleted the threshold_recovery method, its shares[] and share_commitment from the closed recovery policy, so the check has no wire object to run against.
v1 未定义服务端发射路径（客户端 describe 交集纪律 api-conventions.md:423,638 使请求根本不会发出），交集失败是客户端本地判定，不在 wire 上；codes[] 顶层条目（422/type_uri）一并删除。
